descriptions.Daily_Return: Return from Close[t-1] to Close[t]: (Close[t] - Close[t-1]) / Close[t-1]. Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Close_Lag_1: Closing price observed 1 day(s) ago (Close[t-1]). Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Close_Lag_2: Closing price observed 2 day(s) ago (Close[t-2]). Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Close_Lag_3: Closing price observed 3 day(s) ago (Close[t-3]). Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Close_Lag_7: Closing price observed 7 day(s) ago (Close[t-7]). Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Close_Lag_14: Closing price observed 14 day(s) ago (Close[t-14]). Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Close_Lag_30: Closing price observed 30 day(s) ago (Close[t-30]). Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Return_Lag_1: Daily return observed 1 day(s) ago (Daily_Return[t-1]). Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Return_Lag_2: Daily return observed 2 day(s) ago (Daily_Return[t-2]). Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Return_Lag_3: Daily return observed 3 day(s) ago (Daily_Return[t-3]). Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Return_Lag_7: Daily return observed 7 day(s) ago (Daily_Return[t-7]). Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Return_Lag_14: Daily return observed 14 day(s) ago (Daily_Return[t-14]). Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Return_Lag_30: Daily return observed 30 day(s) ago (Daily_Return[t-30]). Available at Close[t].
descriptions.MA_7: 7-day simple moving average of Close up to Close[t]. Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Ratio_Close_MA_7: Ratio of Close[t] relative to MA_7[t]. Normalizes price scale.
descriptions.MA_14: 14-day simple moving average of Close up to Close[t]. Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Ratio_Close_MA_14: Ratio of Close[t] relative to MA_14[t]. Normalizes price scale.
descriptions.MA_30: 30-day simple moving average of Close up to Close[t]. Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Ratio_Close_MA_30: Ratio of Close[t] relative to MA_30[t]. Normalizes price scale.
descriptions.MA_90: 90-day simple moving average of Close up to Close[t]. Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Ratio_Close_MA_90: Ratio of Close[t] relative to MA_90[t]. Normalizes price scale.
descriptions.EMA_7: 7-day exponential moving average of Close up to Close[t]. Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Ratio_Close_EMA_7: Ratio of Close[t] relative to EMA_7[t].
descriptions.EMA_14: 14-day exponential moving average of Close up to Close[t]. Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Ratio_Close_EMA_14: Ratio of Close[t] relative to EMA_14[t].
descriptions.EMA_30: 30-day exponential moving average of Close up to Close[t]. Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Ratio_Close_EMA_30: Ratio of Close[t] relative to EMA_30[t].
descriptions.EMA_90: 90-day exponential moving average of Close up to Close[t]. Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Ratio_Close_EMA_90: Ratio of Close[t] relative to EMA_90[t].
descriptions.Volatility_7: 7-day rolling standard deviation of daily returns up to Day t. Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Price_Std_7: 7-day rolling standard deviation of closing price up to Day t.
descriptions.Volatility_14: 14-day rolling standard deviation of daily returns up to Day t. Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Price_Std_14: 14-day rolling standard deviation of closing price up to Day t.
descriptions.Volatility_30: 30-day rolling standard deviation of daily returns up to Day t. Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Price_Std_30: 30-day rolling standard deviation of closing price up to Day t.
descriptions.RSI_14: 14-day Wilder RSI computed strictly on historical Close up to Day t. Value in [0, 100].
descriptions.MACD: MACD line (EMA_12 - EMA_26) at Day t. Available at Close[t].
descriptions.MACD_Signal: MACD Signal line (9-day EMA of MACD) at Day t. Available at Close[t].
descriptions.MACD_Hist: MACD Histogram (MACD - Signal) at Day t. Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Bollinger_Upper: Upper Bollinger Band (20-day SMA + 2*Std). Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Bollinger_Lower: Lower Bollinger Band (20-day SMA - 2*Std). Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Bollinger_Bandwidth: Bollinger Bandwidth normalized by SMA. Measures volatility expansion/squeeze.
descriptions.Bollinger_PctB: %B indicator showing where Close[t] sits relative to the bands.
descriptions.High_Low_Range: Normalized intraday volatility: (High[t] - Low[t]) / Close[t]. Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Open_Close_Return: Intraday return: (Close[t] - Open[t]) / Open[t]. Available at Close[t].
descriptions.Volume_MA_7: 7-day rolling average volume up to Day t.
descriptions.Volume_Change_1d: 1-day percentage change in Volume: (Volume[t] - Volume[t-1]) / Volume[t-1].
descriptions.Volume_Ratio_MA7: Ratio of Volume[t] to its 7-day average. Highlights volume spikes.
descriptions.Day_Of_Week: Day of week (Monday=0 ... Sunday=6). Fully known at Day t.
descriptions.Month: Month of year (1-12). Fully known at Day t.
descriptions.Quarter: Quarter of year (1-4). Fully known at Day t.
descriptions.Day_Of_Month: Day of month (1-31). Fully known at Day t.
descriptions.Is_Weekend: Binary indicator: 1 if Saturday or Sunday, else 0.
